# Welcome {.unnumbered .unlisted}


This is the online version of **Biostatistics Practicum**, a
graduate textbook in applied biostatistics practice from the
rgtlab Curriculum Project.

The book covers the practical workflow that surrounds
statistical modeling: reproducibility, Git infrastructure,
Docker, Quarto reporting, tidyverse data wrangling, and
clinical-trial case studies. We take Jenny Bryan's STAT 545
[@bryan2019stat545] at UBC as our pedagogical model. The
companion volume,
[*Statistical Computing in the Age of AI*](https://rgtlab.org/scai),
covers the statistical theory and inference that we deliberately
exclude here.

We refer the reader to the [Preface](preface.qmd) for our
motivation and to the [Conventions](conventions.qmd) page for the
visual cues used throughout.
